title: findings.json (submit args.findings)
description: Structural rules of audit_env/grader/matcher.py::parse_submission. Violations make the whole submit invalid (reward -1). Limits apply to the raw lists before de-duplication; explanation length is counted in Unicode code points. 'type' is any string: an unknown type is structurally valid but never matches (FP). episode_id must also equal the current episode (checked by the grader, not expressible here).

claimed_amount_minor.description: JSON integer; booleans, strings and fractions are invalid.

evidence_ids.description: Treated as a set after the 10-item limit.
